claims.text: When AOAP (Aircraft Oil and Parts) is unavailable, the HMMWV (M998-series) engine oil-and-filter change interval is typically stated as every 150 hours of operation or 12 months, based on the earlier limit.
The stated HMMWV (M998-series) engine oil-and-filter change interval is based on standard maintenance procedures for the 6.2L V8 engine in the HMMWV.
The engine crankcase capacity, including the filter, is listed as 6.5 quarts (6.17 liters).
TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 governs the HMMWV engine oil-and-filter change procedures.
